brief.headline: Push for ₹250.00/KG laminate price — we're paying 326.9% above the best internal benchmark

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹250.00/KG for LAMINATE SKU, matching our best internal price
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG — the price we pay Silk Polypack today
priceAsk.basis: Our current Huhtamaki price is ₹1067.36/KG, a 326.9% gap vs best. Even the BOPET film import benchmark sits at 171.60 ₹/kg — raw substrate costs less than half what we're paying them for finished laminate. Closing this gap saves us ₹58850 annually.

paymentTermAsk.summary: No change needed — we already have 30 Days After Receipt

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki India is a ₹2611.64 Cr company with a solid 8.3% EBITDA margin, 5.2% net margin, and low 0.11x debt-to-equity. They're healthy (B 64/100 score, no risk flags) and growing fast — the pre-computed lever cites 22.5%/yr revenue growth. We're ₹76850 spend, which rounds to 0.00% of their revenue, so standalone leverage is negligible. However, their growth appetite and converter economics mean they'll value committed volume; bundle a multi-year commitment or credibly threaten to split volume with UFLEX or Constantia Parikh to earn pricing concessions.

evidence.point: We pay Huhtamaki ₹1067.36/KG for LAMINATE — 326.9% above our best internal price
Closing the price gap saves us ₹58850 per year
The import benchmark for BOPET film substrate is only 171.60 ₹/kg — less than half our laminate price
Huhtamaki's revenue is ₹2611.64 Cr with healthy 8.3% EBITDA and 5.2% net margins
Our ₹76850 spend is 0.00% of their revenue — we need volume commitment or alternate threat for leverage
They carry minimal financial risk: 0.11x debt-to-equity, B health score 64/100, no flags

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant handling both film substrate and conversion at scale — credible full second-source for laminates (health C)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter specializing in pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong GEEP second-source capability

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor's India arm with high-end pharma laminate expertise — premium tier but very reliable alternate

risks: At 0.00% of their revenue we have almost no standalone negotiating power — must bundle volume growth or credibly source elsewhere
The 326.9% gap vs Silk Polypack may reflect spec or quality differences not visible in DATA — verify comparability before hard push
Huhtamaki is financially strong (0.11x leverage, 8.3% EBITDA) and growing 22.5%/yr — they can afford to walk from a ₹76850 customer
Film-maker alternates (Ester, Polyplex, Jindal) supply substrate only, not finished laminate — not drop-in replacements for conversion
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the relationship, but at ₹1067.36/KG we're paying more than four times what we pay other suppliers for comparable laminate — let's discuss how we close that gap and grow volume together.
